data.title: Binance Will Add USDC Quote Pairs into the USDⓈ Trading Market/Tab
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance will add the following trading pairs with USDC as a quote asset into the USDⓈ Trading Market/Tab at 2018/12/15 03:00 AM (UTC):

BNB/USDC, BTC/USDC, ETH/USDC, XRP/USDC, EOS/USDC and XLM/USDC.

At the same time, we will also add a USDC/USDT trading pair into the USDⓈ Trading Market/Tab.

Please note: The existing USDC/BNB and USDC/BTC trading pairs will be removed and delisted at 2018/12/16 03:00 AM (UTC). All existing orders in each order book will also be canceled at this time.

Details:

  1. About USD Coin (USDC)
  2. Fees
  3. Rules

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Learn more about USD Coin (USDC)!

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2018/12/14

 

Find us on

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange
Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance
